# `GuideStep`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Per-frame guiding correction report: star displacement, corrections and quality.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER (observation only) |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, socket_json_guider_server_event::NotifyGuideStep @0x6f1f0 (64-bit guider build); 32-bit counterpart present |

Sent once per guiding correction frame (exposure/controller cadence; no helper rate cap). Sent by the guider process (zwoair_guider) on its TCP 4400 event server to every retained connection (G/all). The main imager process, which is a client of 4400, recognises event lines and forwards them unchanged onto TCP 4700 (I/all), so 4700 clients also receive it; the auxiliary imager process deliberately does not forward 4400 events. The imager's forwarding test is lexical (the exact text "Event":" in the line). Custom guider producer: no lowercase state; ErrorCode is the guide-step error. All member capitalisation is wire-significant (note RADistanceRaw vs DecLimited). Frame, Time, Mount, dx and dy are shown in every READ illustration; IsSettle and IsDither are written unconditionally (READ); RADuration and RADirection are written only when the RA correction duration is positive, and DECDuration and DECDirection only when the Dec duration is positive (READ); the other branch conditions are only partly resolved. Member order on the wire (READ): Frame, Time, Mount, dx, dy, RADistanceRaw, DECDistanceRaw, RADistanceGuide, DECDistanceGuide, RADuration, RADirection, DECDuration, DECDirection, IsSettle, IsDither, StarMass, SNR, AvgDist. No Android app consumer is established. 32-bit parity of the limit and mount-callback branches is not fully established. Ordering against RPC replies and other guider events is not guaranteed; no sequence number, replay or fixed cadence exists. Runtime reachability of the retained guiding functionality on every model is unresolved.

Side effects: Observation only for the receiver.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"GuideStep"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string <seconds>.<nine digits> from clock id 1 (monotonic, INFERRED); not a calendar time. [READ] |
| `Frame` | integer | yes | - | Guide frame number. [READ] |
| `Time` | number | yes | - | Seconds since guiding started, three decimals. Not the Timestamp. [READ (format); INFERRED (origin and unit)] |
| `Mount` | string | yes | - | Mount name. The member is Mount, not GuideStep. [READ] |
| `dx` | number | yes | - | Raw x displacement in camera pixels, read and serialized with no scaling applied in this function. Unscaled, not arcseconds. [READ] |
| `dy` | number | yes | - | Raw y displacement in camera pixels, read and serialized with no scaling applied in this function. Unscaled, not arcseconds. [READ] |
| `RADistanceRaw` | number | no | - | RA distance in arcseconds, despite the "Raw" name. The stored raw RA/Dec displacement pair is multiplied by the camera pixel scale once at the top of the function, and this member is the first (RA) lane of that product. [READ] |
| `DECDistanceRaw` | number | no | - | Dec distance in arcseconds, despite the "Raw" name. The second (Dec) lane of the same pixel-scale product as RADistanceRaw. [READ] |
| `RADistanceGuide` | number | no | - | Guide RA distance; read and serialized with no scaling applied in this function (unlike RADistanceRaw). Probably pixels (INFERRED); not traced to its origin. [READ (no conversion in this function); INFERRED (scale)] |
| `DECDistanceGuide` | number | no | - | Guide Dec distance; read and serialized with no scaling applied in this function (unlike DECDistanceRaw). Probably pixels (INFERRED); not traced to its origin. [READ (no conversion in this function); INFERRED (scale)] |
| `RADuration` | integer | if the RA correction duration is positive | - | RA correction duration; milliseconds INFERRED. Absent when the duration is zero or negative. [READ (type, presence); unit INFERRED] |
| `RADirection` | string | if the RA correction duration is positive | - | RA direction name from a lookup; the literal set is not established. Present exactly when RADuration is present. [READ] |
| `DECDuration` | integer | if the Dec correction duration is positive | - | Dec correction duration; milliseconds INFERRED. Absent when the duration is zero or negative. [READ (type, presence); unit INFERRED] |
| `DECDirection` | string | if the Dec correction duration is positive | - | Dec direction name from a lookup; the literal set is not established. Present exactly when DECDuration is present. [READ] |
| `IsSettle` | integer | yes | - | 1 while the guide controller reports settling, else 0. Always present; a number, not a JSON boolean. One of: `0`, `1`. [READ] |
| `IsDither` | integer | yes | - | One-shot dither flag, cleared when reported, so 1 appears on one step only (READ); set by a dither (INFERRED). Always present; a number, not a JSON boolean. One of: `0`, `1`. [READ] |
| `StarMass` | number | no | - | Star mass, written as the raw number with no scaling in the serializer; its scale (set by the star-measurement code) is unresolved. [READ (type, no scaling); scale unresolved] |
| `SNR` | number | no | - | Signal-to-noise ratio. [READ] |
| `AvgDist` | number | no | - | Average distance; pixels INFERRED. [READ (type); unit INFERRED] |
| `RALimited` | boolean | if the RA-limit branch is selected (flag true) | - | RA correction limited. [READ] |
| `DecLimited` | boolean | if the Dec-limit branch is selected (flag true) | - | Dec correction limited. Note the spelling Dec, unlike DECDuration. [READ] |
| `ErrorCode` | integer | if the guide-step error branch is taken (exact condition unresolved) | - | Guide-step error code; values not enumerated. [READ] |
| `Pos` | array\|null | if the position-append branch is taken (exact condition unresolved) | - | Current mount/point position as two integers, or null. Range: at least 2 item(s). [READ] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.
